verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway is a model-routing and proxy layer. It handles provider routing, failover, BYOK, budgets and observability, so autonomous background automations are a different product category. The ToolLoopAgent code sample is an AI SDK building block, and the coding-agents setup command only connects external agents to the gateway; neither shows the gateway itself scheduling or running background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
